purpose: Comprint-specific ORT WebGPU bounded pending dispatch and buffer-cache policy

transformations.rule: cap each cached-buffer count at 2 for size bins >= 8388608 bytes

limits: GPUBuffer ledger includes live buffers and destroyed buffers pending onSubmittedWorkDone; excludes unobservable driver-private memory and texture storage. Declared GPU cap is enforced before every observed allocation.
